stem: The preliminary analysis being on the whole, reassuring, its confirmation would ____ concerns about the dangers of the project.

The new exhibition of Sophie Calle's work in San Francisco is (i)____ but still (ii)____: given Calle's international stardom and aesthetic reach, the French artist is deserving of a full-career retrospective in America.

Elephants are known to use a wide variety of calls, many of them infrasonic (below the level of human hearing), in coordinating group behavior. The infrasonic calls usually have a component that is (i)____, but these higher frequency aspects of the calls (ii)____ very quickly with distance, so that in the wild, human observers are often (iii)____ sudden coordinated movements of large groups of elephants when no signal was apparent to the observer.
Smi’s analysis of climate change is even more ____ than that supplied by most well-informed writers, and thus deserves serious consideration.
While it is true that the tennis star has been defeated in recent years by some relatively obscure players, counting her out of any tournament, particularly if she is healthy, seems ____.
The artist’s apparently casual, improvisatory pictures are not the ____ renditions they may seem: her pictures are, in fact, the result of a highly disciplined style.
Party leaders hoped to find a single compelling issue that would ____ party members across the country, prompting them to turn out in significant numbers on election day.
